name: parallel_branch_join
description: Marker step where parallel branches re-converge. parent_step_ids enumerates the joined-branch tip steps; branch_ids enumerates their branch ids.

specializations.name: parent_step_ids
specializations.description: Tip steps of every branch being joined (ordered).

specializations.name: branch_ids
specializations.description: Branch ids being joined (ordered, parallel to parent_step_ids).

extension_ranges.description: Capability-owned join-time extensions (e.g. per-branch reduction operator).
